title: Mission to the Moon Cheese Factory
description: Discover the surprising secret behind the moon
template:
Captain {name} and {sidekick} the space {animal} had a very important mission: find out whether the moon was really made of cheese.

They blasted off in a rocket built from a {vehicle} and a lot of duct tape. "Three, two, one, {noise}!" they shouted, and zoomed up into space.

After {number} days of floating around in their socks, the moon appeared, big and round and a little {adj1}. "Houston," said Captain {name}, "I smell something cheesy."

They landed with a bump. Sure enough, the ground was crunchy on the outside and gooey on the inside. {sidekick} took a bite and said, "It's {adj2}! It tastes like {food}!"

Then they found a secret door. Inside was a huge factory full of moon workers, who were round and green and carried {pluralnoun}. Their boss walked up and said, "Welcome to Moon Cheese Inc. We've been expecting you."

"You make cheese out of the moon?" asked Captain {name}.

"No, no," said the boss. "We make the moon out of cheese. It's a very big job. Want to help?"

So Captain {name} put on a hairnet and learned to {verb} the cheese into shape. {sidekick} drove the cheese truck, which went {noise} every time it turned.

At the end of the day, the moon workers gave them a golden wheel of cheese and a ride home. Back on Earth, Captain {name} told everyone the truth, but nobody believed them.

They did notice, though, that the moon looked a little bit smiley that night.
